name: secret-santa
description: Secret Santa PWA — Angular client + Express API

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client && npm install --prefix e2e
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c red,green "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm start --prefix client"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix server && npm run build --prefix client
scripts.test: npm test --prefix server && npm test --prefix client
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix server && npm run lint --prefix client
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build --prefix client && npm test --prefix e2e
